option.value:
# Multi-Stage Build für Angular Frontend FROM node:20-alpine AS builder WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./ RUN npm ci --silent
COPY . . RUN npm run build:prod
# Production: nginx FROM nginx:alpine COPY --from=builder /app/dist/cycling-frontend/browser /usr/share/nginx/html COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
